label: B25-COREMARK-TERMINAL-WRAP-PARSER
title: Normalize Windows JTAG-UART terminal edge redraw for strict CoreMark transcript parsing
reads: T-053 direct-terminal transcript from the one authorized t/v/c session
T-042 strict CoreMark parser/README and upstream raw-field contract
T-054 board runner policy and T-053 task acceptance
scope: Handle only the Windows nios2-terminal 120-column CSI right-margin redraw observed at the end of a CMRESULT line. Normalize one verified duplicate-edge-character redraw before strict parsing; do not edit the captured transcript, waive fields, change expected CRCs/scores, or accept a firmware VALID token without raw upstream cross-check.
acceptance: Positive synthetic regression reproduces the captured 120-column pattern and parses to the independently recomputed score; malformed cursor/duplicate/wrap data, short windows, CRC mismatch, score mismatch, missing upstream fields and error markers remain rejected. The exact T-053 transcript parses in full mode and reports cycles/score cross-checked against raw CoreMark output.
forbidden_regions: rerunning T-053 candidate, t/v/c, or golden transactions
modifying expected CRCs, expected fixed-point formulas, or upstream source
silently stripping arbitrary ANSI/control sequences or generic whitespace
resource: Local parser/unit tests only; no GamePC or heavy local resource lock required.

dispatch.monitoring: integrator-owned sequential offline task; no hardware action
